content.text: In countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe, digital creators face a stark reality: platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are either unavailable or impose restrictions that cripple their ability to sell. For creators [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-beats-online-crypto-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s-every-detail-you|selling]] ebooks, courses, templates, or software, this means lost revenue and limited reach. No-KYC payment gateways like NOWPayments offer a solution, enabling crypto payments without the barriers of traditional platforms. This breakdown explains how to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/build-how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-until-2|Do Not]] a sovereign commerce stack that bypasses these restrictions, giving you full control over your sales infrastructure.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

A no-KYC payment gateway is a system that allows you to accept cryptocurrency payments without requiring identity verification from your buyers. For digital creators in regions with restricted access to platforms like Stripe or PayPal, this is critical. It’s not just about avoiding fees—it’s about accessing a global market. For example, NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee, compared to Gumroad’s 10%. On a $97 product sold 100 times monthly, that’s $921 retained instead of lost to platform fees. This isn’t a workaround; it’s a foundational shift to infrastructure you own and control.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The core of a no-KYC commerce stack is simple: a frontend for product display, a backend for order processing, and a payment gateway for transactions. For hosting, use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages (both free). For backend logic, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle order processing and file delivery. Storage is managed via Supabase or Google Sheets, and files are delivered through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments integrates seamlessly, verifying crypto payments on-chain and triggering automated delivery. The entire system is stateless—once deployed, it operates independently, with no platform dependencies.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators selling products like ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, or software in regions where traditional payment platforms are restricted. If you’re in Nigeria, Kenya, or Venezuela, and platforms like Stripe or Gumroad are unavailable, this stack gives you sovereignty. It’s also for creators who refuse to pay excessive fees or cede control to third parties. By owning your stack, you eliminate platform lock-in and retain more of your earnings. This isn’t a temporary fix—it’s a permanent solution built for long-term resilience.
Retain 99.5% of every sale with NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee—compared to Gumroad’s 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in the stack serves a specific purpose. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront at zero cost. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, processing orders and triggering file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely. NOWPayments acts as the payment gateway, supporting 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. File delivery is automated via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The system is modular—you can swap components as needed. For example, if you prefer Solana or TRON for low transaction fees, NOWPayments supports them out of the box.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing a stack that fits your needs. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys in 48 hours, using GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments. For more advanced needs, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. If you prefer to build yourself, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all 6 blueprints and 7 templates for instant deployment. Each option gives you full ownership of your infrastructure, with no recurring fees or platform dependencies. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to choose your stack and deploy today.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, use a no-KYC payment gateway like NOWPayments integrated with a sovereign commerce stack. Host your ebook on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. When a buyer pays in crypto, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and triggers automated delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This eliminates platform fees and gives you full control over your sales process.
Deploy a fully sovereign commerce stack in 48 hours with no technical expertise required.

If you’re selling notion templates for USDT or Bitcoin, or looking to build a crypto-only digital download store, the principles here apply directly. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all the blueprints and templates you need to deploy a sovereign stack tailored to your products. Whether you’re selling fonts, presets, or software, this kit ensures you own every component of your infrastructure. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Configure order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Automate file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test the entire stack end-to-end to ensure seamless operation. Deploy your storefront and start selling. Monitor transactions and optimize as needed.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are deployed for you within 48 hours. If you prefer to build yourself, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes step-by-step blueprints and templates.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, USDT, and stablecoins on networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON for low transaction fees under $0.10.
Do I need to pay recurring fees?
No. Once deployed, the stack operates without subscriptions or platform fees. The only cost is NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction fee.
Can I scale this stack as my sales grow?
Yes. The infrastructure is designed to scale. Use the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for advanced scaling strategies and additional templates.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
Your stack remains operational. NOWPayments is a stateless component—it verifies payments but doesn’t control your infrastructure. You retain full ownership and control.
